tasks.title: Create and validate the Unity 6.0 LTS project
tasks.objective: Create a Unity project at the repository root with editor 6000.0.64f1, Built-In Render Pipeline, preserving all bootstrap documentation, and verify batch-mode licensing/logs.
mustNotTouch: Root bootstrap Markdown (except required status updates)
acceptance: Unity project opens with the selected 6000.0.64f1 editor
Built-In Render Pipeline is used; no URP/HDRP package is added
Bootstrap files remain intact
Batch-mode Unity command produces a log and exit code
Any license/activation failure is recorded as a blocker, not hidden
Package manifest and project settings are recorded for approval

checks.name: Project existence
checks.evidence: Assets/ (empty), Packages/, ProjectSettings/ exist at repository root

checks.name: Unity batch launch
checks.evidence: Exit code 0. TestResults/unity-create.log

checks.name: Compile smoke check
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; no error CS/Exception/Shader error matches. TestResults/unity-compile-smoke.log

result.summary: Unity project created at the repository root with editor 6000.0.64f1, Built-In Render Pipeline, and a minimal built-in package baseline plus UGUI/TextMeshPro and Unity Test Framework. Batch launch and compile smoke check both exited 0.
result.notes: The first batch launch failed with exit 198 because the Unity Personal offline license validity period had expired. The human refreshed the license through Unity Hub; the retry succeeded. An unquoted project path caused a stray log file at C:\Users\Asus\Desktop\AI; deletion is blocked by project permissions and requires cleanup approval.

tasks.title: Review and approve baseline package manifest and project settings
tasks.objective: Record the exact package manifest and project settings generated by project creation; remove nothing without approval and add no third-party package.
acceptance: Manifest contains only the agreed baseline packages/built-in modules
Render pipeline is Built-In
Any deviation or package change is presented for human approval
Rollback/checkpoint exists before settings changes

checks.name: Manifest review
checks.evidence: 34 direct dependencies, all Unity built-in/editor-bundled. No URP/HDRP or third-party runtime package. com.unity.multiplayer.center removed with approval.

checks.name: Settings review
checks.evidence: 6000.0.64f1; Built-In RP; Linear color space; Legacy Input Manager; Medium quality; windowed 1920x1080 resizable; company LaundryLegends; product 'Laundry Legends'.

checks.name: Post-change Unity reopen
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; lock file updated to 37 packages; settings persisted; no error CS/Exception/Shader error matches.

result.summary: Human approved the recommended baseline. Applied Linear color space, company/product naming, Medium quality, windowed 1920x1080 resizable display, and removal of the unused com.unity.multiplayer.center package. Unity reopened cleanly and persisted the settings.
result.notes: Approval was recorded in-session on 2026-10-19. Cleanup of the stray Desktop log remains blocked by shell permissions and was excluded from this task.

checks.name: Assembly reference audit
checks.evidence: Runtime has no references; Editor references runtime; both test assemblies reference LaundryLegends.Runtime, UnityEngine.TestRunner, UnityEditor.TestRunner, and nunit.framework.dll.

checks.name: Folder structure
checks.evidence: 33 directories covering Scripts features, Scenes, Prefabs, Art, Audio, Settings, ScriptableObjects, UI, Editor, and Tests.

result.summary: Created the Assets/LaundryLegends feature folder tree and four assembly definitions. The runtime assembly compiled to LaundryLegends.Runtime.dll with exit code 0. Test and editor assemblies are correctly configured but intentionally empty until their first scripts/tests.
result.notes: Unity emitted 'will not be compiled because it has no scripts' for the editor and test assemblies. This is expected at this stage and is not a compile error.

tasks.title: Implement minimal GameState and scene routing
tasks.objective: Implement a simple persistent GameState foundation and route from Bootstrap to MainMenu/Laundromat.
acceptance: Bootstrap initializes services without errors
Scene routing reaches MainMenu and Laundromat
No static mutable global money/order state
GameState lifetime is documented

checks.name: PlayMode scene-flow test
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; BootstrapRoutesThroughMainMenuToLaundromat passed.

checks.name: Scene component validation
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; Bootstrap contains GameSession + BootstrapController; MainMenu contains MainMenuController; no missing scripts.

result.summary: Implemented instance-based GameState, a persistent GameSession created by Bootstrap, and a single SceneRouter. Bootstrap routes to MainMenu and MainMenu routes to Laundromat. A PlayMode test verifies the full route and session persistence.
result.notes: GameState has no public money mutator; EconomyService will be the single writer later. GameSession.Instance is a service handle only. ARCHITECTURE documents the lifetime.

tasks.title: Implement first-person movement, camera, and interaction stub

acceptance: Player moves and looks smoothly
Esc opens a minimal pause overlay and releases the cursor; Resume closes it and locks the cursor
Interaction raycast reports a target in range
No new input package added

checks.name: PlayMode player tests
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; 4/4 PlayMode tests passed, including PlayerMovesAndLooks, PauseStopsTimeAndResumeRestoresIt, and InteractionRaycastFindsTargetInRange.

checks.name: Player prefab and scene validation
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; Player prefab, camera, CharacterController, pause, interaction, floor, and light present; no Input System package.

checks.name: Manual movement check
checks.evidence: Unrun. Cursor lock/release and subjective movement feel require a human playtest; batch tests skip cursor APIs.

result.summary: Implemented a CharacterController-based first-person player with mouse look, a minimal Esc pause overlay, cursor lock/release, and a camera-raycast interaction stub. Created the Player prefab and placed it in Laundromat with a temporary floor and directional light. Automated movement, look, pause, and interaction tests pass.
result.notes: Manual cursor/feel check remains unrun. The temporary floor and light are placeholders for LL-P1-007. No Input System package was added.

tasks.title: Build greybox laundromat environment and lighting
tasks.objective: Create a readable greybox room with floor, walls, entrance, counter, machine wall, folding area, and basic lighting.
acceptance: Player can walk the room without falling through geometry
Scale reads correctly for a person, counter, and machines
Critical paths have collision
Lighting reveals interaction surfaces
Secret access is foreshadowed but not open

checks.name: Greybox build
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; GreyboxRoom prefab created with 8 machines, counter, folding table, secret door, and 4 point lights; TemporaryFloor removed.

checks.name: Greybox validation
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; floor support at 8 points, wall containment on 5 rays, secret door collider, 4 point lights, and player spawn validated.

checks.name: PlayMode traversal and regression suite
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; 8/8 passed, including PlayerWalksIntoRoomAndIsBlockedByMachineWall, PlayerCannotWalkThroughEastWall, SecretDoorIsPresentAndClosed, RoomHasPointAndDirectionalLighting, and all four prior tests.

checks.name: Preview capture and agent inspection
checks.evidence: Exit code 0; TestResults/greybox-entrance.png and greybox-secret.png captured and inspected: room, machine wall, counters, closed secret door, and lighting are visible.

checks.name: Human visual check
checks.evidence: Unrun. Agent-inspected screenshots exist, but subjective scale, lighting quality, and comfort require a human Game-view check.

result.summary: Built a reproducible greybox laundromat prefab: 16x12 m room, entrance gap, machine wall with 8 washer/dryer boxes, counter, folding table, ceiling, four point lights, directional fill, and a closed foreshadowed secret door. Placed it in Laundromat, moved the player spawn inside the entrance, and removed the temporary floor. Added automated traversal, wall-containment, secret-door, scale, and lighting tests.
result.notes: Human visual check remains unrun. The room is greybox placeholder geometry with flat Standard materials; no final art, machine behavior, UI, or interaction is implemented. PlayerSetupTool now recognizes GreyboxRoom as the walkable floor and no longer requires TemporaryFloor.
